user.title: SMS Gammu Viewer Setup
user.description:
Enter the address and credentials for the sms-gammu-gateway add-on.

Don't have it yet? Install the "sms-gammu-gateway" add-on by PavelVe first (search the Add-on Store or check the integration's README for the link).

⚠️ Before continuing, disable these in the add-on's settings: SMS monitoring, auto-delete read SMS, call monitoring, and MQTT (if enabled). This integration handles all of that itself — leaving them on causes message loss and conflicts.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect to the gateway. Check the address and port.

settings.title: SMS Gammu Viewer Settings
settings.description: Configure polling interval and notification targets.

data.notify_targets: Devices to notify on new SMS
data.collect_interval: Delay between scans while assembling a multipart SMS (seconds)
data.collect_empty_max: Number of empty scans before considering the SMS complete

call_entities.title: Call entities
call_entities.description: Each entity dials a fixed phone number when triggered — useful for things like an intercom or gate that opens on an incoming call.

call_entity_form.title: Call entity
call_entity_form.description: Cover entities open when called and can auto-close once the call ends. Button entities just dial the number.

data.name: Entity name
data.auto_close: Auto-close the cover once the call ends

call.name: Call
call.description: Dials a number via the modem voice AT interface. Requires voice port configured.
